edition.title: This weekend on Keowee + Jocassee
edition.dek: Jazz on the Alley keeps its Thursday residency in Ram Cat Alley — the city hadn't posted an October lineup as of this writing, so it's a surprise headliner this week. Both breweries carry the weekend from there: Keowee Brewing has Amy Kincaid Friday and Angela Easterling Saturday, plus a First Friday Fish & Chips special. Jocassee Valley Brewing goes bigger on Saturday with its own Octobeerfest — German food, the PaddleSplash Awards at noon, and music into the evening — then closes Sunday with West End Strings. Walhalla PAC's and Visit Oconee's own event pages were blocking automated access when we checked, so we're leaving anything unverified off this week's list rather than guess.

events.title: Jazz on the Alley
events.body: Seneca's Thursday-night institution keeps going through October: free live jazz on historic Ram Cat Alley, with the Happy Hour Showcase warming up the street beforehand. The city's flyer confirms the series runs every Thursday through October, but hadn't named this week's headliner as of this writing — check the page below before you head down.
events.note: Free · Happy Hour Showcase 5:30–6:30pm, main set 7–9pm · Ram Cat Alley, downtown Seneca · this week's act wasn't posted yet

events.title: First Friday specials and live music at both breweries
events.body: Keowee Brewing runs a First Friday Fish & Chips special most of the day and has Amy Kincaid playing that evening. Over in Salem, Jocassee Valley Brewing has Chris Wayne with the Just a Smile Caribbean food truck out front.
events.note: Free · Keowee Brewing Fish & Chips 11am–9pm, music 6:30–8:30pm · Jocassee Valley Brewing music 6:30pm, food truck from 4pm

events.title: Octobeerfest at Jocassee Valley Brewing
events.body: Jocassee Valley Brewing's own spin on Oktoberfest — German food from multiple vendors, the PaddleSplash Awards at noon, and music running Water Kickers in the early afternoon into Jaguar 4 that evening.
events.note: German food & vendors 11am–7pm · PaddleSplash Awards 12pm · Water Kickers 1:30pm, Jaguar 4 6:30pm · Jocassee Valley Brewing, Salem

events.title: Live music at Keowee Brewing
events.body: A quieter Saturday option in Seneca if Octobeerfest isn't your scene: Angela Easterling plays the taproom on Main Street.
events.note: Free · 6:30–8:30pm · Keowee Brewing, 401 E Main St, Seneca

events.title: Live music closes the weekend at Jocassee Valley Brewing
events.body: West End Strings plays an early-evening set, with Farm to Fire Fermentery pizza out front. A calmer way to end the weekend than Saturday's Octobeerfest crowd.
events.note: Free · Music at 4pm · open 12–7pm · Jocassee Valley Brewing, Salem

plan.title: First Friday fish & chips, then pick a brewery
plan.body: Start with Keowee Brewing's First Friday Fish & Chips special, then decide between Amy Kincaid in Seneca or Chris Wayne in Salem for the evening.

plan.title: Get a paddle in before Octobeerfest
plan.body: Saturday's the busy one between Jocassee Valley's Octobeerfest and Keowee Brewing's Angela Easterling set — launch early and beat both the heat and the crowd.

plan.title: A swim, then West End Strings closes it out
plan.body: Nothing else dated during the day — pick a swim spot, check today's lake level, and save West End Strings at Jocassee Valley Brewing for the late afternoon.
